name: SSD1306 OLED 128x64
description: SSD1306 OLED module (128x64 or 128x32) on I2C at 0x3C or 0x3D: write-only control bytes and commands, the three addressing modes, segment and COM remap, multiplex, offset and start line, the charge pump the panel needs to light, scrolling at the panel's frame rate. The image shows on the board view.

address.doc: I2C address: 60 (0x3C) or 61 (0x3D), as the module's SA0 jumper sets it

rows.doc: The panel's rows: 64 (a 0.96-inch 128x64 module, wired for the alternative COM configuration) or 32 (a 0.91-inch 128x32, sequential)

external_vcc.doc: The module supplies the panel's high voltage itself (most do not: they rely on the internal charge pump)

outputs.name: pixels
outputs.doc: SVG path of the lit pixels (one unit per pixel)

outputs.name: checksum
outputs.doc: FNV-1a of the visible image (row by row, 8 pixels a byte, leftmost the high bit)

functional.claims: Write-only I2C with control bytes (Co, D/C#); every command with its arguments; the three addressing modes; the panel image through segment remap, COM scan direction, multiplex ratio, offset, start line and the COM pins configuration against the panel's wiring (interleaved rows when wrong); the module's panel mounted so A1/C8 show the RAM upright; lit only with the charge pump (or external VCC) and 100 ms after display on; horizontal and vertical scrolling at the frame rate from the divide ratio, pre-charge phases and multiplex ratio, the RAM left scrolled by 2Eh; no answer below 1.65 V.
omissions: the oscillator frequency setting's effect on the frame rate (370 kHz whatever D5h's upper nibble)
RAM written during an active scroll (written as when idle; the datasheet calls it undefined)

timed.claims: Write-only I2C with control bytes (Co, D/C#); every command with its arguments; the three addressing modes; the panel image through segment remap, COM scan direction, multiplex ratio, offset, start line and the COM pins configuration against the panel's wiring (interleaved rows when wrong); the module's panel mounted so A1/C8 show the RAM upright; lit only with the charge pump (or external VCC) and 100 ms after display on; horizontal and vertical scrolling at the frame rate from the divide ratio, pre-charge phases and multiplex ratio, the RAM left scrolled by 2Eh; no answer below 1.65 V.
omissions: the oscillator frequency setting's effect on the frame rate (370 kHz whatever D5h's upper nibble)
RAM written during an active scroll (written as when idle; the datasheet calls it undefined)

electrical.claims: Pins bridge to analog nets with the family's pin-model defaults; VCC's voltage gates the interface; the behaviour is the Lua model's.
omissions: the oscillator frequency setting's effect on the frame rate (370 kHz whatever D5h's upper nibble)
RAM written during an active scroll (written as when idle; the datasheet calls it undefined)

sources.title: Solomon Systech SSD1306 128x64 Dot Matrix OLED/PLED Segment/Common Driver with Controller, datasheet Rev 1.1

fr.description: Module OLED SSD1306 (128x64 ou 128x32) sur I2C en 0x3C ou 0x3D : octets de contrôle et commandes en écriture seule, les trois modes d'adressage, le remappage des segments et des COM, le multiplexage, le décalage et la ligne de départ, la pompe de charge dont la dalle a besoin pour s'allumer, le défilement à la fréquence d'image de la dalle. L'image s'affiche sur la vue de la carte.

functional.claims: I2C en écriture seule avec octets de contrôle (Co, D/C#) ; chaque commande avec ses arguments ; les trois modes d'adressage ; l'image de la dalle à travers le remappage des segments, le sens de balayage des COM, le taux de multiplexage, le décalage, la ligne de départ et la configuration des broches COM face au câblage de la dalle (lignes entrelacées en cas d'erreur) ; la dalle du module montée pour que A1/C8 montrent la RAM à l'endroit ; allumée seulement avec la pompe de charge (ou un VCC externe) et 100 ms après l'activation de l'affichage ; défilement horizontal et vertical à la fréquence d'image tirée du rapport de division, des phases de précharge et du taux de multiplexage, la RAM laissée défilée par 2Eh ; aucune réponse sous 1,65 V.
omissions: l'effet du réglage de fréquence de l'oscillateur sur la fréquence d'image (370 kHz quel que soit le quartet haut de D5h)
le contraste en tant que luminosité (une sortie seulement)
le fondu et le zoom (commandes du SSD1306B)
la RAM écrite pendant un défilement actif (écrite comme au repos ; la fiche technique la dit indéfinie)
